scope: Presentation of the live console, the offline catalog and report and the hosted bridge page: the technical graphics standard, numbered wayfinding with a Guide page, pending run timing and readable quantities, and their checks. Not a qualification of the web service, the hosted bridge, any deployment or any CI execution

authority.instruction: go through every web view and page of the kiln website and make the UI and UX make sense to a new and advanced user. make it nasa graphics standard. usgraphics company like.
authority.reading: change the presentation and wayfinding of the browser surfaces in this repository, in the working copy
not_read_as: synchronization of the delta into accepted specifications
publication to Radicle or a mirror

source.state: uncommitted jj working copy on top of the parent revision

manifest.method: BLAKE3 of the b3sum listing of the 24 changed paths outside .cairn/changes/adopt-technical-graphics-standard/, sorted by path, as they stood when the Cargo and node rails below ran

environment.toolchain: rustc 1.88.0 and cargo 1.88.0 from the host rustup, the channel rust-toolchain.toml pins. nix develop did not reach cargo: twice it waited on a busy Nix evaluation-cache SQLite database and printed no build output, so the dev shell was not used
environment.openssl: openssl-sys built against an existing store OpenSSL 3.6.4 (/nix/store/sbbghw4j32smy8hfbvvcbqvbafi6d66i-openssl-3.6.4 with its -dev output) through the store pkg-config wrapper 0.29.2, because the host has no system OpenSSL. The flake pins its own nixpkgs OpenSSL; this is not that derivation
environment.cargo_target_dir: /home/brittonr/.cargo-target-kiln-full, an existing Kiln target directory; the host disk was 98% full
environment.node: v26.8.1 from the host, not the flake nodejs
environment.browser: Chromium 157, headless, driven by the omp browser helper
environment.cairn: host executable that accepts cairn-policy/generated/cairn-policy.json; it reports no version

rails.command: node --check on web.js, ui.js, source.js, project.js and work.js
cargo test --locked -p kiln-dashboard -p kiln-web-service -p kiln-hosted -p onix-kiln-cli

not_run.reason: outside this presentation change's surface; not run

offline_documents.bound: rendered outside the repository and not retained; the same inputs render the same bytes

browser_review.method: The console was served by a throwaway Node server outside the repository that reads the real assets from the working tree on every request, sends the console's response policy (minus HSTS) and answers the API from synthetic data shaped from the service serializers, with the work, code-review and source stores proxied to a preview backend. The hosted page was served the same way, with bridge.rs's /app.css join. The catalog and report are the rendered files above, served from a local static server
browser_review.bound: Synthetic data and one headless Chromium. Not the kiln-web-service or kiln-hosted executables, not a deployment, not Firefox or Safari, not a touch device and not a screen reader

console.error_capture_control: a console.error injected into the page was captured with level error
console.explicit_appearance_override: theme=dark under a light system scheme resolved color-scheme dark and the dark page colour; theme=light under a dark system scheme resolved light
console.focus_ring: 2px solid ink on the refresh button
console.guide: four general key rows and all 15 code-review shortcuts listed; the state legend draws the real status pills
console.empty_workspace: Overview offered Open 1.3 CI projects and Read 0.0 Guide
console.signed_out: sign-in panel shown; the token field and the connect button are 44px tall; no horizontal overflow
console.rail_current_destination: on Settings the rail scrolled itself by 31px so the current destination is fully inside it; the page did not scroll
console.accessible_names: rail link names carry no section number
console.custom_work_status: a team status renders as a neutral custom cell titled Custom status: in_review (not a built-in status)
console.reduced_motion: with reduce, the mark's lit door stays amber without animation, the live icon is still, motion tokens are 0ms and the running count text remains. The no-preference case could not be emulated in this browser and was not observed

hosted_page.horizontal_overflow: 0, measured in dark; light was reviewed by screenshot only
